description: The callee's report settles the task (the report a local skill server sends over the SAME P26 socket; Debug-marked like step.steer and terminal.* — a report is product control for the connected app, never the S19 projection). A cost is OPTIONAL and its absence records `unknown · cost-not-reported`, never zero (O2: absent is not zero). The task layer answers a settled task with the refusal that names its state — this method cannot settle one twice (T3's idempotence, unchanged).
